item.title: My Script: Closing Statement
item.description:
1. Do you have any questions for us? (VERY IMPORTANT)

“Yes, I do:

  • What does the typical ‘Day in the Life’ of an SDET look like in your team?
  • How does the QA team collaborate with Developers and Product Owners here?
  • What is the biggest challenge your automation team is currently facing?
  • How do you measure the success of an SDET in this role?”

2. Final Closing

“Thank you for the detailed conversation today. I’m very excited about the possibility of joining [Company Name]. I believe my background in EdTech and my hands-on experience with Java/Selenium frameworks align perfectly with what you’re looking for. I look forward to hearing from you soon!”
